steps: Dice the onion and the carrot small. Mince the garlic. Drain and rinse the white beans.
Heat the olive oil in a pot over medium heat, about 1 minute, until it shimmers.
Add the onion and carrot and cook 5 minutes, stirring, until the onion is soft and translucent.
Add the garlic and the dried oregano and cook 30 seconds, until fragrant.
Pour in the crushed tomatoes and the vegetable broth. Simmer 10 minutes, until the carrot is tender.
Add the beans and simmer 5 minutes more, until heated through and the stew thickens slightly.
Mash a ladle of beans against the pot to thicken it. Under 12 months, blend a portion smooth. Keeps 4 days; freezes 2 months.
